text: This report recommends the award of audio-visual (AV) equipment supply and installation for the Community Conservation Centre to a vendor.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Authorized the Director, Capital Program and Sustainability, or her designate, to award and enter into an Agreement with Solotech for the supply and installation of Audio Visual (AV) equipment within the Toronto Zoo Community Conservation Centre in the amount of $950,000.00 excluding HST.
